title: 稻草人 Tiū-chháu-lâng
mood: standing in for someone who is gone
subject: a scarecrow wearing a grandfather's shirt in a field about to be sold
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien rock with beiguan instruments taking the functional roles a rock band would otherwise fill. Beiguan gongs, cymbals and drums carrying the entire rhythm section in place of a kit, beiguan suona playing the lead melodic line with its piercing double-reed cut, long-necked gekkin as the primary stringed voice, electric guitar and bass supporting underneath rather than leading. Loud and clattering with the traditional percussion close and forward and no modern drum reinforcement. Male voice, open and projecting, unsentimental, keeping the traditional breath placement without the weeping enka vibrato. 138 BPM, D minor pentatonic. Standing in for someone who is gone. No drum kit, no synth, no sobbing melisma, no sentimental ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
阿公的草人 徛佇田中央 三十冬
衫是阿公的 帽仔是阿公的 連彼个徛法攏是阿公的
鳥仔頭一冬會驚 第二冬就無驚矣
阿公講「毋是欲驚鳥仔 是欲予我看著田裡有人」

[Chorus]
稻草人 無跤 袂走
伊徛佇遐 替阿公徛
阿公無佇咧 伊猶原徛
規个田攏無人 伊猶原徛

[Verse]
今年風透 共伊吹倒
阮共伊插轉去 阮無共伊換衫
彼領衫已經破甲欲無形
阮猶是無換 換咧就毋是伊矣

[Chorus]
稻草人 無跤 袂走
伊徛佇遐 替阿公徛
阿公無佇咧 伊猶原徛
規个田攏無人 伊猶原替阮徛

[Outro]
田賣掉矣 下個月
草人 阮欲共伊搬轉去
